description: The baker's own sourdough starters in Loafy: name, birthday and age, notes and story, how many bakes each went into and when last, each with its id and a link. A new starter is add_starter, a change to one is update_starter. Needs the baker's Loafy account.
name: list_my_starters

input.description: The arguments as the tool used them, after any correction.

note.description: A remark on the whole result, such as why nothing was found.

notes.description: What was corrected or left out, such as a value outside its range.

bakes.description: How many bakes it went into.

birthday.description: The day it was started, YYYY-MM-DD.

id.description: The starter's id, which update_starter takes.

url.description: The same answer, recipe or entry on loafy.ai.

title: My Loafy starters
